# Figure 1: case time series, covariate correlations, and station map

```{r, eval = TRUE}
covariate_case_correlation <- function(df, cov_col, cov_month_start, cov_month_end,
                                       city, covariate_label,
                                       pf_month_start = 8, pf_month_end = 11) {
  cov_df <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(month >= cov_month_start, month <= cov_month_end) |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(cov = mean(.data[[cov_col]]))

  pf_df <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(month >= pf_month_start, month <= pf_month_end) |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(PF = sum(PF))

  cov_df |>
    left_join(pf_df, by = "year") |>
    mutate(city = city, covariate = covariate_label)
}

raw_ahmedabad <- read_csv("data/Ahmedabad/dataset_Ahmedabad_2023.csv")
raw_surat <- read_csv("data/Surat/dataset_Surat_2023.csv")

cases_df <- bind_rows(
  raw_ahmedabad |> mutate(date = make_date(year, month, 1)) |> select(date, PF) |> mutate(city = "Ahmedabad"),
  raw_surat |> mutate(date = make_date(year, month, 1)) |> select(date, PF) |> mutate(city = "Surat")
)

irs_introduction <- tibble(
  date = c(
    make_date(2012, 1),
    make_date(2017, 1)
  ),
  city = c("Ahmedabad", "Surat")
)


p1 <- cases_df |> ggplot(aes(x = date, y = PF)) +
  facet_grid(city ~ .) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = .5) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = date),
    data = irs_introduction,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.title.y = element_markdown()) +
  labs(
    x = "Time", y = "Observed *P. falciparum* cases", color = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica")
  )

all_corr <- bind_rows(
  covariate_case_correlation(raw_ahmedabad, "hadISD", 8, 9, "Ahmedabad", "Relative Humidity"),
  covariate_case_correlation(raw_ahmedabad, "Max_Temp", 9, 9, "Ahmedabad", "Maximum Temperature"),
  covariate_case_correlation(raw_surat, "hadISD", 7, 7, "Surat", "Relative Humidity"),
  covariate_case_correlation(raw_surat, "Max_Temp", 5, 9, "Surat", "Maximum Temperature")
)

all_corr2 <- all_corr %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      city == "Surat" & year <= 2016 ~ "1997–2016",
      city == "Surat" & year <= 2018 ~ "2017–2018",
      city == "Surat" ~ "2019+",
      city == "Ahmedabad" & year <= 2011 ~ "1997–2011",
      city == "Ahmedabad" & year <= 2018 ~ "2012–2018",
      city == "Ahmedabad" ~ "2019+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("1997–2011", "1997–2016", "2012–2018", "2017–2018", "2019+"))
  )

p2 <- all_corr2 %>%
  filter(year >= 1997) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cov, y = PF, label = year)) +
  facet_grid(city ~ covariate, scales = "free") +
  geom_smooth(
    data = all_corr2 %>% filter(
      (city == "Ahmedabad" & year <= 2011) |
        (city == "Surat" & year <= 2016)
    ),
    method = "lm",
    color = "black", fill = "gray"
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = period, shape = period), size = 1.4) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(aes(label = after_stat(r.label)),
    color = "black", geom = "label", size = 2, data =
      all_corr2 %>%
        filter(
          (city == "Ahmedabad" & year <= 2011) |
            (city == "Surat" & year <= 2016)
        )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown(),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Average Covariate",
    y = "Observed *P. falciparum* cases",
    color = ""
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "2012–2018" = "#0072B2",
      "2017–2018" = "#0072B2",
      "2019+"     = "#D55E00",
      "1997–2011" = "black",
      "1997–2016" = "black"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "2012–2018" = 17,
      "2017–2018" = 17,
      "2019+"     = 15,
      "1997–2011" = 16,
      "1997–2016" = 16
    )
  )

print(p2)

library(sf)
library(patchwork)
library(basemaps)
library(ggspatial)

shape_file <- read_sf("../Datasets_Malaria/India_Data/States/Admin2.shp")
shape_file2 <- st_transform(shape_file, crs = st_crs(3857))

endemic_states <- shape_file |> filter(ST_NM %in% c("Chhattisgarh", "Jharkhand", "Odisha", "Gujarat"))

df_station <- read_csv("../Datasets_Malaria/India_Data/India_station_list.csv")
points_sf <- st_as_sf(df_station, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = st_crs(endemic_states))

endemic_stations <- st_join(points_sf, endemic_states, join = st_within) |>
  drop_na() |>
  left_join(df_station) |>
  rename(state = ST_NM) |>
  select(state, id, name, lat, long) |>
  mutate(name = stringr::str_to_title(name)) |>
  filter(!(name %in% c("Bhuj", "Rajkot", "Daltonganj"))) |>
  mutate(
    name = factor(name, levels = c("Ahmedabad", "Surat", "Balasore", "Bhubaneshwar", "Jharsuguda", "Birsa Munda", "Jamshedpur", "Jagdalpur", "Pbo Raipur", "Pendra Road", "Swami Vivekananda")),
    state = factor(state, levels = c("Gujarat", "Odisha", "Jharkhand", "Chhattisgarh"))
  )

map <- basemap_ggplot(shape_file2,
  map_service = "esri", map_type = "world_physical_map"
) +
  geom_sf(
    data = shape_file2, fill = NA,
    color = NA, linewidth = .4,
    color = "black", alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_sf(aes(color = state),
    data = endemic_stations, size = 1.5
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    aes(
      label = name,
      geometry = geometry, color = state
    ),
    data = endemic_stations, stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 2, force = 0.5,
    force_pull = 0.1, max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "#D55E00", # vermillion
    "#0072B2", # blue
    "#009E73", # bluish green
    "#CC79A7", # reddish purple
    "#E69F00" # orange
  )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 6, base_family = "sans") +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr",
    which_north = "true", style = north_arrow_nautical,
    height = unit(1.3, "cm"), width = unit(1.3, "cm"),
    pad_x = unit(.3, "cm"), pad_y = unit(.3, "cm")
  ) +
  annotation_scale(
    pad_x = unit(.4, "cm"),
    pad_y = unit(.3, "cm"), text_cex = .7
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 7, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Helvetica")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"), legend.position = "none")

(p1 / (p2 | map)) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

ggsave(here::here("figures/figure1.pdf"), units = "mm", width = 180, height = 185, dpi = 1000)
```

# Figure: wavelet power spectra

```{r, eval = TRUE}
library(RColorBrewer)
df_ahmedabad <- read_csv("data/Ahmedabad/dataset_Ahmedabad_2023.csv") |>
  mutate(date = make_date(year, month, 1))

df_ahmedabad <- df_ahmedabad |>
  mutate(
    `Relative Humidity` = stats::filter(hadISD, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    `Maximum Temperature` = stats::filter(Max_Temp, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    Cases = stats::filter(PF, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    date = make_date(year, month, 1)
  ) |>
  select(date, `Relative Humidity`, `Maximum Temperature`, Cases) |>
  remove_missing()

df_surat <- read_csv("data/Surat/dataset_Surat_2023.csv")

df_surat <- df_surat |>
  mutate(
    `Relative Humidity` = stats::filter(hadISD, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    Cases = stats::filter(PF, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    `Maximum Temperature` = stats::filter(Max_Temp, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    date = make_date(year, month, 1)
  ) |>
  select(date, `Relative Humidity`, `Maximum Temperature`, Cases) |>
  remove_missing()

invisible(capture.output(wc <- analyze.wavelet(df_ahmedabad, "Relative Humidity", dt = 1 / 12)))
invisible(capture.output(wc2 <- analyze.wavelet(df_ahmedabad, "Cases", dt = 1 / 12)))
invisible(capture.output(wc3 <- analyze.wavelet(df_ahmedabad, "Maximum Temperature", dt = 1 / 12)))

invisible(capture.output(wc4 <- analyze.wavelet(df_surat, "Relative Humidity", dt = 1 / 12)))
invisible(capture.output(wc5 <- analyze.wavelet(df_surat, "Cases", dt = 1 / 12)))
invisible(capture.output(wc6 <- analyze.wavelet(df_surat, "Maximum Temperature", dt = 1 / 12)))

p2 <- plot_wavelet(list(Ahmedabad = list(wc, wc2, wc3), Surat = list(wc4, wc5, wc6))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black")) +
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(5.5, "lines")) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box.spacing = margin(-1, 0, 0, 0),
    text = element_text(family = "sans")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.vjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(2000, (2000 + 2020) / 2, 2020),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = ~ format(make_date(floor(.x), round(12 * (.x - floor(.x)) + 1), 1), "%Y")
  ) + labs(x = "Time")

print(p2)

ggsave("figure_wavelet.pdf", height = 120, width = 180, dpi = 600, unit = "mm")
```

# Figure: cross wavelet power

```{r, eval = TRUE}
df <- read_csv("data/Ahmedabad/dataset_Ahmedabad_interpolated.csv") |> filter(year(date) >= 1997)
cases_df <- read_csv("data/Ahmedabad/dataset_Ahmedabad_2023.csv") |>
  mutate(date = make_date(year, month, 1)) |>
  select(date, PF)

daily_df_ahmedabad <- df |>
  group_by(year = year(date), month = month(date)) |>
  summarize(
    max_temp = max(temp), min_temp = min(temp),
    temp = mean(temp), dew = mean(dew), humidity = mean(humidity)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    humidity = stats::filter(humidity, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    temp = stats::filter(temp, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    max_temp = stats::filter(max_temp, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    min_temp = stats::filter(min_temp, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    date = make_date(year, month, 1)
  ) |>
  left_join(cases_df) |>
  # mutate(PF = stats::filter(PF, rep(1 / 12, 12))) |>
  remove_missing()

df <- read_csv("data/Surat/dataset_Surat_hadISD_raw.csv") |>
  filter(year(date) >= 1997) |>
  rename(humidity = RH)
cases_df <- read_csv("data/Surat/dataset_Surat_2023.csv") |>
  mutate(date = make_date(year, month, 1)) |>
  select(date, PF)

daily_df_surat <- df |>
  group_by(year = year(date), month = month(date)) |>
  summarize(
    max_temp = max(temp), min_temp = min(temp),
    temp = mean(temp), dew = mean(dew), humidity = mean(humidity)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    humidity = stats::filter(humidity, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    temp = stats::filter(temp, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    max_temp = stats::filter(max_temp, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    min_temp = stats::filter(min_temp, rep(1 / 12, 12)),
    date = make_date(year, month, 1)
  ) |>
  left_join(cases_df) |>
  # mutate(PF = stats::filter(PF, rep(1 / 12, 12))) |>
  remove_missing()

invisible(capture.output(wc <- analyze.coherency(daily_df_ahmedabad, my.pair = c("humidity", "PF"), dt = 1 / 12, lowerPeriod = 0.5, date.format = "%Y-%m-%d", loess.span = 0)))
invisible(capture.output(wc2 <- analyze.coherency(daily_df_ahmedabad, my.pair = c("temp", "PF"), dt = 1 / 12, lowerPeriod = 0.5, date.format = "%Y-%m-%d", loess.span = 0)))
invisible(capture.output(wc3 <- analyze.coherency(daily_df_ahmedabad, my.pair = c("max_temp", "PF"), dt = 1 / 12, lowerPeriod = 0.5, date.format = "%Y-%m-%d", loess.span = 0)))

invisible(capture.output(wc4 <- analyze.coherency(daily_df_surat, my.pair = c("humidity", "PF"), dt = 1 / 12, lowerPeriod = 0.5, date.format = "%Y-%m-%d", loess.span = 0)))
invisible(capture.output(wc5 <- analyze.coherency(daily_df_surat, my.pair = c("temp", "PF"), dt = 1 / 12, lowerPeriod = 0.5, date.format = "%Y-%m-%d", loess.span = 0)))
invisible(capture.output(wc6 <- analyze.coherency(daily_df_surat, my.pair = c("max_temp", "PF"), dt = 1 / 12, lowerPeriod = 0.5, date.format = "%Y-%m-%d", loess.span = 0)))

p1 <- plot_wavelet_coherence(list(Ahmedabad = list(wc, wc3), Surat = list(wc4, wc6)), "wp") +
```

# Figures 2 and 3: model predictions with best-fit parameters

```{r, eval = FALSE}
predict_from_profile <- function(filtered_res, city, covariate, end_year, window_start, window_end,
                                 dataset_path, k = 1) {
  filtered_res |>
    get_top_sample(k = k) |>
    predict_model(city,
      n_sims = 1000,
      model = "inf_exponent", covariate = covariate,
      start_year = 1997, start_month = 1,
      end_year = end_year, end_month = 12,
      end_year_prediction = 2023, end_month_prediction = 12,
      window_start = window_start, window_end = window_end,
      dataset = dataset_path, output_format = "data.frame"
    ) |>
    mutate(city = city)
}

surat_result_temp <- read_csv("aggregated_results/profile_Surat_Max_Temp_1997_2016_5_9_new.csv") |>
  filter(rho >= 0.01, bH < 0 ) |>
  predict_from_profile("Surat", "Max_Temp",
    end_year = 2016, window_start = 5, window_end = 9,
    dataset_path = "data/Surat/dataset_Surat_2023.csv"
  )

surat_result_rh <- read_csv("aggregated_results/profile_Surat_hadISD_1997_2016_7_7.csv") |>
  filter(rho >= 0.01) |>
  predict_from_profile("Surat", "hadISD",
    end_year = 2016, window_start = 7, window_end = 7,
    dataset_path = "data/Surat/dataset_Surat_2023.csv"
  )

ahmedabad_result_rh <- read_csv("aggregated_results/profile_Ahmedabad_hadISD_1997_2011_8_9.csv") |>
  filter(mode == "refined_second", rho >= 0.01) |>
  select(-mode, -profile_var, -source_file) |>
  predict_from_profile("Ahmedabad", "hadISD",
    end_year = 2011, window_start = 8, window_end = 9,
    dataset_path = "data/Ahmedabad/dataset_Ahmedabad_2023.csv"
  )

ahmedabad_result_temp <- read_csv("aggregated_results/profile_Ahmedabad_Max_Temp_1997_2011_9_9.csv") |>
  filter(rho >= 0.01) |>
  predict_from_profile("Ahmedabad", "Max_Temp",
    end_year = 2011, window_start = 9, window_end = 9,
    dataset_path = "data/Ahmedabad/dataset_Ahmedabad_2023.csv"
  )

dataset <- ahmedabad_result_rh |>
  mutate(covariate = "Relative Humidity") |>
  rbind(ahmedabad_result_temp |> mutate(covariate = "Maximum Temperature")) |>
  rbind(surat_result_rh |> mutate(covariate = "Relative Humidity")) |>
  rbind(surat_result_temp |> mutate(covariate = "Maximum Temperature"))

CI <- 0.95

plot_prediction_panel <- function(dataset, city_name, ylim_max) {
  colors <- c("#000000", "#0072B2", "#D55E00")
  colors2 <- c("#FFFFFF", "#B3D5E6", "#EFC0AF")
  training <- dataset |> filter(city == city_name, type == "training")

  dataset |>
    filter(city == city_name) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = PF, fill = type, color = type)) +
    facet_wrap(~covariate) +
    ggdist::stat_lineribbon(.width = CI, linewidth = 0.5) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 7, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = max(training$time), linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      x = "Time", y = "Observed *P. falciparum* cases", color = "",
      fill = "", title = city_name
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = colors, labels = c("Data", "Training", "Prediction"),
      breaks = c("data", "training", "prediction")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = colors2, drop = TRUE, labels = c("Data", "Training", "Prediction"),
      breaks = c("data", "training", "prediction")
    ) +
    # coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, ylim_max)) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_markdown(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box.spacing = margin(-1, 0, 0, 0),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.key.height = unit(10, "pt"),
      legend.key.width = unit(10, "pt"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 10, b = 2, l = 2, unit = "pt")
    )
}

p_ahmedabad <- plot_prediction_panel(dataset, "Ahmedabad", 1600)
print(p_ahmedabad)
ggsave(here::here("figures/figure2.pdf"), plot = p_ahmedabad, height = 70, width = 180, dpi = 1000, unit = "mm")

p_surat <- plot_prediction_panel(dataset, "Surat", 2000)
print(p_surat)
ggsave(here::here("figures/figure3.pdf"), plot = p_surat, height = 70, width = 180, dpi = 1000, unit = "mm")
```

# SM Figure, prediction from 2019 onwards Ahmedabad

```{r, eval = FALSE}

predict_from_profile_different_year <- function(filtered_res, city, covariate, end_year, actual_end_year, window_start, window_end,
                                                dataset_path, k = 1) {
  filtered_res |>
    get_top_sample(k = k) |>
    predict_model(city,
      n_sims = 1000,
      model = "inf_exponent", covariate = covariate,
      start_year = 1997, start_month = 1,
      end_year = end_year, end_month = 12,
      actual_end_year = actual_end_year,
      end_year_prediction = 2023, end_month_prediction = 12,
      window_start = window_start, window_end = window_end,
      dataset = dataset_path, output_format = "data.frame"
    ) |>
    mutate(city = city)
}

    end_year = 2018,

  mutate(covariate = "Relative Humidity") |>
  rbind(ahmedabad_result_temp |> mutate(covariate = "Maximum Temperature")) |>
  rbind(surat_result_rh |> mutate(covariate = "Relative Humidity")) |>
  rbind(surat_result_temp |> mutate(covariate = "Maximum Temperature"))

p_ahmedabad <- plot_prediction_panel(dataset, "Ahmedabad", 1600)
print(p_ahmedabad)
ggsave(here::here("figures/Ahmedabad_prediction_2019.pdf"), plot = p_ahmedabad, height = 70, width = 180, dpi = 1000, unit = "mm")

p_surat <- plot_prediction_panel(dataset, "Surat", 2000)
print(p_surat)
ggsave(here::here("figures/Surat_prediction_2019.pdf"), plot = p_surat, height = 70, width = 180, dpi = 1000, unit = "mm")
```

# Figure: scaled covariate windows

```{r, eval = FALSE}
covariate_window <- function(city, covariate, window_start, window_end) {
  dat_df <- str_glue("data/{city}/dataset_{city}_2023.csv")
  read_csv(dat_df) |>
    filter(month >= window_start, month <= window_end) |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(mean_covariate = mean(!!sym(covariate))) |>
    mutate(city = city, covariate = if_else(covariate == "hadISD", "Relative Humidity", "Maximum Temperature"))
}

all_df <- bind_rows(
  covariate_window("Ahmedabad", "hadISD", window_start = 8, window_end = 9),
  covariate_window("Ahmedabad", "Max_Temp", window_start = 9, window_end = 9),
  covariate_window("Surat", "hadISD", window_start = 7, window_end = 7),
  covariate_window("Surat", "Max_Temp", window_start = 5, window_end = 9)
) |>
  group_by(city, covariate) |>
  mutate(mean_covariate = (mean_covariate - min(mean_covariate)) / (max(mean_covariate) - min(mean_covariate))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      city == "Surat" & year <= 2015 ~ "a",
      city == "Surat" & year <= 2018 ~ "b",
      city == "Surat" ~ "c",
      city == "Ahmedabad" & year <= 2011 ~ "a",
      city == "Ahmedabad" & year <= 2018 ~ "b",
      city == "Ahmedabad" ~ "c",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

colors <- c("#000000", "#0072B2", "#D55E00")

all_df |> ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_covariate, color = type, group = 1)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(covariate), rows = vars(city), scales = "free_y") +
  geom_step(direction = "mid") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = colors,
    breaks = c("a", "b", "c")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Scaled covariate")

ggsave("figure_covariates.pdf", dpi = 600, width = 10, height = 7)
```
